propositions: Token usage from external-integration.yml and prompt-eval.yml weekly jobs is not retrievable; usage is computed in PydanticAIRunner.run but lost before job completion
A new usage_log module must record token counts (input/output/cache/requests) to a JSONL file when REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var is set, and provide a CLI to summarize the file as Markdown
Both weekly workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to a temp file path, append summarize output to GitHub job summary, and upload the raw JSONL as a run artifact
The runner must call usage_log.record() at the existing _usage seam after attaching usage to the result, with no-op behavior when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset
Unit tests must verify record/summarize semantics offline, the no-op path when env var is unset, CLI invocation, and the seam integration via FunctionModel override
